name: Dual-Wall Institutional Corridor Containment
thesis: 212 of 212 stocks (100.0%) are currently trading strictly inside their institutional corridor between Put Wall support and Call Wall resistance. Dealers actively hedge inventory to keep prices bound inside this corridor.
action: Trade range reversions at the boundaries (Buy CE at Put Wall, Buy PE at Call Wall) when stock is inside corridor.

name: Long Gamma Volatility Squelch Hegemony
thesis: 132 stocks (62.3%) are in positive Net GEX. In Long Gamma regimes, dealer hedging dampens volatility by buying down-moves and selling up-moves, preventing runaway breakouts and enforcing mean-reversion.
action: Avoid buying naked OTM options in Long Gamma stocks; favor selling spreads or buying ATM options with strict profit taking.

name: Call Wall Pin Trap & Physical Delivery Defense
thesis: 3 stocks (including BOSCHLTD, INOXWIND, MRF) are trading within 0.5% of their Call Wall. Institutional call writers face 100% physical delivery penalties on ITM options and will defend these strikes aggressively as expiry nears.
action: Fade breakouts at the Call Wall; buy ATM Puts or sell OTM Calls with stop loss just above the Call Wall.

name: Put Wall Floor Absorption & Bounce Trap
thesis: 4 stocks (including BOSCHLTD, GMRINFRA, MRF, PAGEIND) are trading within 0.5% of their Put Wall floor. Institutional put writers defend their short put assignments, triggering strong absorption bounces.
action: Enter bullish bounce trades (Buy ATM Calls) when price sweeps Put Wall and rejects with hammer/absorption candle.
